messages:
ashley_s: Quick sync: Lagoon Health is moving to a 3-week POC. They want to evaluate a fine-tuned 13B qlora variant (edge tokenizer) + embeddings. Need catalog fit, privacy notes, and a POC pricing sketch.
punit_ops: Short answer: Dedicated eu-west is fastest for POC. We can stand up a canary pool and add BYOK + VPC peering.
yara_eng: Technical ask: does their adapter change tokenization? "edge tokenizer" could mean special pre-tokenization steps. We need tokenizer.json and sample tokenized outputs to validate sequence lengths.
ashley_s: I'll request tokenizer files and a 50-sample dataset. Sam, can you nudge the customer for that?
sam_sales: On it. I'll push for adapter tar + tokenizer + 20 sample prompts.
punit_ops: Perf/infra note: For streaming + kv cache, recommend min 3 nodes A100-80GB reserved for POC. With int8 we expect p95 ~160-220ms for 1.5k tokens depending on burst.
yara_eng: Also check for custom ops (RMSNorm/SiLU variants). If present we may need to build a custom runtime image. That impacts timeline.
mike_sec: Security checklist: EU data residency only, BYOK flow needed, standard NDA signed. They also asked about audit logging retention and delete-on-request flow. I'll assemble answers.
ashley_s: Pricing: customer wants a POC estimate. Punit, can you provide a rough number for 3 weeks with reserved mini-pool + support?
punit_ops: Rough: $8k setup + $3k/week reserved pool + usage true-up. I'll refine and send to Sam.
yara_eng: Action items: 1) Sam to get artifacts (today). 2) Yara to run tokenizer/compat scan (within 48h). 3) Punit to draft POC quote (24h). 4) Mike to send security FAQ (48h).
tickets-bot: Created ticket POC-2099 Lagoon Health onboarding (assignees: punit_ops,yara_eng,mike_sec)
ashley_s: Thanks team. If tokenizer needs special handling we may hook them into Private, but let's try Dedicated first. Will update after artifact scan. :thumbsup:
